set.approach: Gym Wall is the open steep slab on the left side heading down the trail into West Gully, on the west side of Scorpion Butte. Reach it by rappelling in from the top of Scorpion Butte or by following the steep switchback trail to the middle of the gully. The route is reached via Gym Crack.

review.notes: Area pages for access; route page only says approach via Gym Crack. No descent source.
